journey.name: wear restore invalid checksum
journey.description:
A phrase made of wordlist words that fails the BIP39 checksum shows Invalid phrase. Review walks through the words again from the first with the typed words in place, and fixing the last word continues to the passphrase step. Emulator and physical watch.
Precondition: Fresh app, see journeys/wear/README.md › Fresh app. Backend: none; the journey stops before the wallet is saved. The word screens block screenshots, so check them with `android layout` only.

actions.action: Type `abandon` twelve times (README › Typing several words, with the list changed to twelve times `abandon`)
Verify the word field (tag "RestoreWordInput") still reads "abandon"
Replace the word with `about` (README › Replacing a word)
Verify the passphrase screen: the title (tag "RestorePassphraseTitle") reads "Passphrase?"
